title: THE PIXEL RING, POSTS AND RACKS
why: Job 86e ship 5: with the pixel look on, the extraction ring line, the Undercroft station posts, mainframe racks and the dropped crate are cached scene sprites through pixWrap. Pulses, blinking lights, fills and icons stay live.
now: With the pixel look on, extraction rings and the Undercroft posts, racks and dropped crates draw as crisp pixel art. With the look off nothing changes.
